comment.text: A tooltip title for a sidebar item used during the onboarding tour to highlight specific interface sections.

usage.context:
// the sidebar's own label so the wording in the tooltip is the wording on
 // screen and the names are not translated twice.

 navItemStep(
 sidebarSelector("forms-recent"),
 t("FormsTour:FormsPlacesTitle"),
 places.join(" "),
 callbacks,
 LOG_LABEL,
 true,
 leaveSpace,
